original.name: invtRootSubmodule.eq_span_root
original.statement: Type*} [Field K] [NeZero (2 : K)] [Module K M] [Module K N] {P : RootPairing ι K M N} [P.IsRootSystem] (q : P.invtRootSubmodule) : (q : Submodule K M) = span K (P.root '' {i | P.root i ∈ (q : Submodule K M)})

have_tree.name: hSQ
have_tree.type: span K (P.root '' {i | P.root i ∈ Q}) ≤ Q

have_tree.name: htQ
have_tree.body: by simpa using Q.sub_mem hv (hSQ hs)
